<description>
Migrating a legacy wallet that holds no spendable material fails whenever the
wallet contains transactions. `migratewallet` returns
`std::bad_function_call (-1)` and the wallet is left unmigrated.

Two defects are involved, and the first one hides the second.

### 1. The migration check reads in-memory state that has not been updated yet

When the wallet being migrated has no spendable material,
`CWallet::ApplyMigrationData()` asserts that nothing is left behind in it:

```cpp
if (!m_address_book.empty()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all address book records were migrated")};
if (!mapWallet.empty()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all transaction records were migrated")};
```

The two checks look symmetric but are not. `DelAddressBookWithDB()` erases from
`m_address_book` straight away, so the first check sees current state.
`RemoveTxs()` only erases the transaction records from disk; it defers the
`mapWallet` removal to the db txn's `on_commit` listener, which does not run
until the txn is committed — after `ApplyMigrationData()` has returned.

`mapWallet` is therefore never empty at that point and the check always fails.

### 2. Aborting the txn calls a callback that was never set

`DbTxnListener` declares `on_commit` and `on_abort` as plain `std::function`
members and callers may set only the one they need. `RemoveTxs()` does exactly
that: `on_commit` is set, `on_abort` is left empty.

`TxnCommit()` and `TxnAbort()` each invoked their listener's callback
unconditionally, so the abort triggered by the failed check above threw
`std::bad_function_call`. The exception escaped the wallet entirely, replacing
the real error with an unhelpful one and skipping the caller's cleanup path.

### Fix

The first commit skips callbacks that are not set, and documents that they are
optional. The second discounts the transactions already queued for deletion
instead of requiring `mapWallet` to be empty.

They are kept separate because the second defect masks the first: with only the
listener fix applied, the migration surfaces the real error
`Error: Not all transaction records were migrated (-4)` instead of
`std::bad_function_call (-1)`.

### Testing

`src/wallet/test/db_tests.cpp` gains a regression test covering a listener with
only one callback set, for both commit and abort. It fails on master with
`std::bad_function_call` and passes with the fix.

`test/functional/wallet_migration.py` gains a case migrating a blank legacy
wallet with a watch-only address that has received a transaction. The test is
taken from #36483.

To reproduce on master, apply the functional test alone and run
`wallet_migration.py`.

Fixes #36483
</description>

<commits>
72889f7e1e wallet: skip unset db txn listener callbacks

DbTxnListener declares on_commit and on_abort as plain std::function
members and callers may set only the one they need. RemoveTxs() does
exactly that: it registers a listener with on_commit set and on_abort
left empty.

TxnCommit() and TxnAbort() invoked both unconditionally, so aborting a
db txn in which RemoveTxs() had run threw std::bad_function_call. The
exception escaped the wallet, replacing the error that caused the abort
with an unhelpful "std::bad_function_call" RPC error and skipping the
caller's cleanup path.

Skip callbacks that are not set, and document that they are optional.

50f254e53a wallet: fix migration of watch-only wallets

When the wallet being migrated has no spendable material,
ApplyMigrationData() asserts that no records are left behind in it. The
address book half of that check works because DelAddressBookWithDB()
erases from m_address_book straight away. The transaction half cannot:
RemoveTxs() only erases the records from disk and defers the mapWallet
removal to the db txn's on_commit listener, which runs after
ApplyMigrationData() has returned.

mapWallet is therefore never empty at that point, so migrating a
watch-only wallet that has transactions always failed with
"Error: Not all transaction records were migrated".

Discount the transactions queued for deletion instead.
</commits>

diff --git a/src/wallet/walletdb.h b/src/wallet/walletdb.h
index 7099d36248..9ddba5caac 100644
--- a/src/wallet/walletdb.h
+++ b/src/wallet/walletdb.h
@@ -185,6 +185,8 @@ public:
 
 struct DbTxnListener
 {
+    //! Callbacks are optional. An empty std::function means the listener has
+    //! nothing to do for that outcome, and is skipped.
     std::function<void()> on_commit, on_abort;
 };
 
diff --git a/src/wallet/walletdb.cpp b/src/wallet/walletdb.cpp
index 25bdf7eb88..7521503bb5 100644
--- a/src/wallet/walletdb.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/walletdb.cpp
@@ -1365,7 +1365,7 @@ bool WalletBatch::TxnCommit()
     bool res = m_batch->TxnCommit();
     if (res) {
         for (const auto& listener : m_txn_listeners) {
-            listener.on_commit();
+            if (listener.on_commit) listener.on_commit();
         }
         // txn finished, clear listeners
         m_txn_listeners.clear();
@@ -1378,7 +1378,7 @@ bool WalletBatch::TxnAbort()
     bool res = m_batch->TxnAbort();
     if (res) {
         for (const auto& listener : m_txn_listeners) {
-            listener.on_abort();
+            if (listener.on_abort) listener.on_abort();
         }
         // txn finished, clear listeners
         m_txn_listeners.clear();
diff --git a/src/wallet/wallet.cpp b/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
index d6cc7ff728..ed49704df4 100644
--- a/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
@@ -4063,7 +4063,11 @@ util::Result<void> CWallet::ApplyMigrationData(WalletBatch& local_wallet_batch,
     // migrated records will be presented to the user.
     if (!has_spendable_material) {
         if (!m_address_book.empty()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all address book records were migrated")};
-        if (!mapWallet.empty()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all transaction records were migrated")};
+        // Unlike DelAddressBookWithDB(), which updates m_address_book straight away, RemoveTxs()
+        // only erases the transactions from disk here; it defers the mapWallet removal to the db
+        // txn's on_commit listener, which runs after this function returns. The transactions
+        // queued for deletion are therefore still in mapWallet and must be discounted.
+        if (mapWallet.size() != txids_to_delete.size()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all transaction records were migrated")};
     }
 
     return {}; // all good
diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_migration.py b/test/functional/wallet_migration.py
index 6e032ae20d..14914d6ee9 100755
--- a/test/functional/wallet_migration.py
+++ b/test/functional/wallet_migration.py
@@ -1178,6 +1178,25 @@ class WalletMigrationTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
 
         wallet.unloadwallet()
 
+    def test_watchonly_txs_no_privkeys(self):
+        self.log.info("Test migrating a wallet with only watch-only addresses imported and no spendable material with transactions.")
+        default = self.master_node.get_wallet_rpc(self.default_wallet_name)

+        wallet.importaddress(addr)
+
+        # Create a transaction that spends to the address
+        received_txid = default.sendtoaddress(addr, 10)
+        self.generate(self.master_node, 1)
+
+        wallet.gettransaction(received_txid)
+
+        res, wallet = self.migrate_and_get_rpc("watchonly_no_privkeys")
+
+        wallet.unloadwallet()
+
     def test_migrate_simple_watch_only(self):
         self.log.info("Test migrating a watch-only p2pk script")
         wallet = self.create_legacy_wallet("bare_p2pk", blank=True)
@@ -1788,6 +1807,7 @@ class WalletMigrationTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.test_avoidreuse()
         self.test_preserve_tx_extra_info()
         self.test_blank()
+        self.test_watchonly_txs_no_privkeys()
         self.test_migrate_simple_watch_only()

diff --git a/src/wallet/test/db_tests.cpp b/src/wallet/test/db_tests.cpp
index 818b176cef..c4d03e3fee 100644
--- a/src/wallet/test/db_tests.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/test/db_tests.cpp
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
 #include <wallet/sqlite.h>
 #include <wallet/migrate.h>
 #include <wallet/test/util.h>
+#include <wallet/walletdb.h>
 #include <wallet/walletutil.h>
 
 #include <cstddef>
@@ -306,5 +307,39 @@ BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(in_memory_database_cannot_reopen)
     BOOST_CHECK_THROW(database.Open(), std::runtime_error);
 }
 
+BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(txn_listener_unset_callback_is_skipped)
+{
+    // A DbTxnListener may leave either callback unset. The unset one must be
+    // skipped rather than invoked, which would throw std::bad_function_call.
+    DatabaseOptions options;
+    DatabaseStatus status;
+    bilingual_str error;
+    std::unique_ptr<SQLiteDatabase> database = MakeSQLiteDatabase(m_path_root / "sqlite", options, status, error);
+
+    // Only on_commit set: aborting must not throw, and must not run on_commit.
+    {
+        WalletBatch batch{*Assert(database)};
+        BOOST_CHECK(batch.TxnBegin());
+        bool committed{false};
+        batch.RegisterTxnListener({.on_commit = [&] { committed = true; }, .on_abort = {}});
+        bool aborted{false};
+        BOOST_CHECK_NO_THROW(aborted = batch.TxnAbort());
+        BOOST_CHECK(aborted);
+        BOOST_CHECK(!committed);
+    }
+
+    // Only on_abort set: committing must not throw, and must not run on_abort.
+    {
+        WalletBatch batch{*Assert(database)};
+        BOOST_CHECK(batch.TxnBegin());
+        bool rolled_back{false};
+        batch.RegisterTxnListener({.on_commit = {}, .on_abort = [&] { rolled_back = true; }});
+        bool committed{false};
+        BOOST_CHECK_NO_THROW(committed = batch.TxnCommit());
+        BOOST_CHECK(committed);
+        BOOST_CHECK(!rolled_back);
+    }
+}
+
 BOOST_AUTO_TEST_SUITE_END()
 } // namespace wallet

</patch>
